payload.text: Molt 1.4.12: resleeve drops utilz's decision-18 warning, because liberators/utilz.sh:117 writes it to stderr and lib/molt.sh:2722 runs each check with 2>/dev/null. Fix: drop the >&2, and add a bats case that runs the warning through resleeve. molt-dc builds it (S) on devbin-vc's GO of 24 Nov. The cut waits for devbin 0.1.31's sweep and carries hold 10's fallback drop.
